== Biography ==
Margaret was born in 1745. She was baptised on 5 May 1745 at West Calder, Midlothian; the transcripts provide no exact birth day. The entry names father John Glasgow and mother Margaret Anderson. Her selected father-profile link to [[Glasgow-2847|John Glasgow]] remains 89% probable, while the attached mother [[Anderson-83671|Margaret Anderson]] has no separate adult-identity grade in this review.
